title: Man dies in custody
article: RCMP are investigating the possibility bad drugs were responsible for the death of a suburban Vancouver man who died struggling with police and a paramedic.
Mladen Kujko, 33, of Burnaby was the second man to die in police custody in British Columbia within 24 hours, and police are looking for a possible connection.
A 47-year\-old man from the Lower Mainland collapsed and died Sunday night after being restrained by Squamish RCMP, north of Vancouver.
